segmentation.text: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer
shall stop in obedience to a stop sign or yield in compliance with a yield sign,
in compliance with the manner prescribed in subsection 1 [NRS-484B-257-1],
if a stop sign or a yield sign is erected at one or more entrances thereto
although not a part of a through highway
to vehicles not so obligated to stop or yield
and which are within the intersection
or approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard
during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

elements.justification: 'Traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic, of which the subject is a member; 'being controlled by a police officer' is dev.human_direction of role police_officer ('a person directing traffic') governing (dev.governs) the subject's approach carrier c or X (st.travel_region), read at the subject's entry.
A dev.traffic_signal governing c or X (dev.governs) that is not dev.inoperative ('installed and uncovered but showing no valid indication'), read at the subject's entry.
Same mapping as 'The driver of a vehicle' in the index: the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'driver' is the vehicle's controlled motion.

'Stop' is DEF-NRS-484A-255, 'complete cessation from movement' (drv.motion.complete_halt); 'in obedience to a stop sign' ties the halt to a dev.stop_sign ('regulatory sign requiring a full halt') governing (dev.governs) the subject's approach carrier c or X. 'Yield in compliance with a yield sign' (dev.yield_sign, 'regulatory sign requiring yielding without a mandatory halt'), in the manner subsection 1 prescribes ('in the event of a yield sign, slowed or stopped'), is the subject's kin.speed within the place's stopping zone at or below the speed from which it still halts at the place (p.yield_line_speed_max), a halt included. The act is owed at the place that manner names, which the act's own atoms read: the st.stop_line marking c (st.entrance_of), else the st.crosswalk marking c, else c's entrance end, the side along c's direction (st.lane_direction) given by prim.region_offset_along, the body-to-mark distance by st.region_geometry, the subject on c by rel.occupies.

'Prior to entering an intersection': the act is owed before the subject's entry into X - the observation at which its footprint comes to overlap X (rel.occupies), having occupied at the previous observation a carrier c entering X (st.lane_enters, st.travel_region).

'A stop sign or a yield sign is erected at one or more entrances thereto': a dev.stop_sign or dev.yield_sign governs (dev.governs) an approach carrier of X (st.lane_enters) or X; the sign the subject obeys is the one governing its own entrance c, which it occupies (rel.occupies).

residues.why: 'although' is concessive: the duty reaches signed entrances whether or not the intersection is part of a through highway, and the stop or yield owed at a signed entrance is the same in both cases (subsection 1 states the same act where it is part of one); the words withhold the duty nowhere.

applicability: At the subject's entry into an intersection X: the observation at which its footprint overlaps X and did not at the previous observation, where at that previous observation it occupied a carrier c with st.lane_enters(c, X); where at the entry observation a stop sign or a yield sign governs c or X (dev.governs); except where at that observation a police officer's direction (dev.human_direction of role police_officer) governs c or X, or a traffic signal that is not inoperative governs c or X.
obligation: NRS_484B_257_1_o1 (binder subject to subject) is complied with at the entry - the manner subsection 1 prescribes - and the act it states is found on the approach: where a stop sign governs c or X, a complete halt (drv.motion.complete_halt, speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance); where only a yield sign does, an observation at which kin.speed is at or below p.yield_line_speed_max (a halt included); in either case while occupying c within the stopping zone of the place for c, in subsection 1's order: (1) a stop line marking c's entrance (st.entrance_of), the line ahead of or at the reference point along c's direction (prim.region_offset_along at or above zero), the body within p.stop_point_tolerance of it; (2) where no stop line marks c (entrance lists observed and excluding c), the crosswalk marking c's entrance ahead, not overlapped, the body within p.stop_point_tolerance of it; (3) where neither marks c, the footprint outside X and the body within p.stop_point_tolerance of X. History bound: the search runs back from the entry and ends at the approach start - the last observation before the entry at which the subject, on a carrier the place marks, is outside the place's stopping zone upstream (off the mark, short of it along c's direction and farther than p.stop_point_tolerance; where several marks of that kind mark c, outside and short of each) - or at the subject's previous entry into X, whichever is later. Act found: compliant; either end reached without it: violated; neither end reached (the recording begins inside the zone): unknown. Each entry owes its own act; only an observed exit from the zone upstream begins a new approach. The entry is unknown where the previous observation does not show the subject on a mapped carrier; where a mark's association with c is unobserved and the verdict turns on it, unknown. No bound is taken from the recording's start, a first observation or a cumulative distance.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever or whatever controls it.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A dev.stop_sign governs carrier c entering X; a st.stop_line marks c; no officer or operating signal. The subject passes the line and enters X with kin.speed well above p.halt_speed_tolerance, never halting since it was upstream of the line's stopping zone.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same scene; the subject halts on c with the line just ahead within p.stop_point_tolerance, then enters X.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: No stop or yield sign governs c or X; the subject enters X without halting.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: Stop sign governing c; kin.speed is absent, so whether the subject halted is unknown.

scenarios.name: history_boundary
scenarios.narrative: Stop sign governing c; the recording begins with the subject already within p.stop_point_tolerance of the stop line, moving slowly; no halt is recorded before its entry into X.
scenarios.boundary: the approach start: the subject's last observation outside the stop line's stopping zone upstream on c lies before the recording

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: Only a dev.yield_sign governs c; no stop line or crosswalk marks c; the subject reaches X's edge at kin.speed at or below p.yield_line_speed_max and enters.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: A stop sign governs c, but an operating dev.traffic_signal (circular_red) also governs c at the subject's entry.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's kinematic channels

param_proposals.name: p.stop_point_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the body-to-mark gap within which a halt counts as at the mark: a stop line's set-back before a crossing plus a placement margin
param_proposals.source: MUTCD stop line placement in advance of a crosswalk

param_proposals.name: p.yield_line_speed_max
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a vehicle at the place of a yield sign counts as having slowed: the speed from which a passenger car can still halt within the stop-point tolerance at a comfortable deceleration of about 4.5 m/s^2
param_proposals.source: AASHTO comfortable deceleration rate of the stopping sight distance model
